DEPOSIT_PENDING.title: Confirm the order?

QC.title: Ready for inspection?
QC.body: All stages are complete and the goods are ready to inspect.

READY_TO_SHIP.title: Inspection passed?
READY_TO_SHIP.body: The goods passed inspection and can ship.

SHIPPED.title: Mark as shipped
SHIPPED.body: The goods have left on the booked shipment. The buyer gets the tracking details and documents.

COMPLETED.title: Complete the order?
COMPLETED.body: Everything arrived as agreed. The balance is released to the factory.

DISPUTED.title: Report a problem
DISPUTED.body: GarmentGate reviews the order with both sides. Tell us what went wrong.

REWORK.title: Send the order back for rework?
REWORK.body: The factory fixes the defects the inspector found, then the goods are inspected again.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: A sample lets you check fit, fabric and finish before bulk. Reorders of an approved style can skip it.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: The factory ships it soon; you’ll get the tracking number here.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: Your sample has shipped: review it
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: Approve it, or tell the factory what to change (photos help).

CONFIRM_ORDER.title: Sample approved: confirm the order
CONFIRM_ORDER.body: Confirming issues your purchase order; production starts once the deposit arrives.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Pay the {deposit} deposit
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Payment details are on your purchase order. Production starts as soon as it arrives.

PRODUCTION.title: In production: {stage}

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered: is everything right?
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Complete the order, or report a problem within 14 days.

RESOLVE_DISPUTE.body: GarmentGate is working with the factory and will update you.

DONE.title: Order completed

CANCELLED.title: Order cancelled
CANCELLED.body: Message GarmentGate if you have questions.

PAY_BALANCE.body: The factory ships as soon as it arrives. Funds stay in escrow until each milestone.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Nothing to do right now
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: We’ll let you know when it’s your turn.

CANCELLED.body: Message GarmentGate if you have questions.

open.title: Report a problem
open.body: GarmentGate reviews the order with both sides and decides, including any refund from escrow. Production pauses while the dispute is open.
open.done: Dispute opened. GarmentGate will be in touch.

resolve.title: Resolve the dispute
resolve.body: Both sides are notified. The factory never sees refund amounts.
resolve.resolutionHint: Shown to both sides (the factory’s copy is scrubbed of the buyer’s names).
resolve.refundHint: Optional. Up to {max} is still in escrow.

admin.title: Disputes
admin.description: Take a dispute on, check the evidence and resolve it from the order.
admin.emptyBody: When a buyer reports a problem on an order, it shows up here.
admin.toReview: {count, plural, one {# file to review} other {# files to review}}

reviews.title: Reviews

intro.BUYER: Rate the factory. Your review is shown on its profile with your country only.
intro.MANUFACTURER: Rate the buyer. Only GarmentGate and the buyer see it.

reviews.theirsPending: The other side has left a review. You’ll see it once you leave yours, or after the review period.
reviews.closed: The review period for this order has ended.

commentPlaceholder.BUYER: How was the quality, fit and finish? Would you order again?
commentPlaceholder.MANUFACTURER: Were the specs clear? Was the buyer responsive?

reviews.publicEmptyBody: Reviews appear here after buyers complete orders with this factory.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: How the marketplace is doing, and what’s waiting for the team.

kpis.gmvHint: {count, plural, one {# confirmed order} other {# confirmed orders}}, at buyer prices
kpis.activeHint: From sampling to delivery, incl. disputes
kpis.conversionHint: {converted, number} of {rfqs, number} RFQs became an order

overview.skipped: Orders in {currencies} are left out of the USD totals: they have no exchange rate yet.

charts.gmvBody: Confirmed orders at the buyer price, in USD, by month of confirmation.
charts.revenueBody: Markup paid by buyers plus commission withheld from factories, in USD.
charts.conversionBody: Share of RFQs published each month that became an order.

table.show: Show the monthly figures as a table

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Every order with both sides’ prices and the platform’s revenue.
orders.emptyBody: Orders appear here when a buyer accepts a quote.

override.title: Override the status of {code}
override.body: It’s {status} now. This skips the normal checks, so only use it to fix a mistake or record something agreed outside the platform. Both sides are notified.
override.reasonHint: Saved in the order history and the audit log.

refund.title: Refund on {code}
refund.body: Refunds come out of escrow that hasn’t been released yet: up to {max}.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Confirm buyer transfers, release escrow to factories and record payouts.
payments.released: Tranche released to the factory’s payable

empty.confirmBody: Bank transfers and LCs appear here once a buyer marks them as sent.
empty.releaseBody: Tranches become due as orders reach their milestones.
empty.payBody: Released tranches wait here until the bank transfer to the factory is recorded.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm {reference}
confirmDialog.body: {amount} from {buyer}. Check it against the bank statement before confirming.
confirmDialog.upload: Upload the statement, SWIFT copy or LC
confirmDialog.bankReferenceHint: As it appears on the statement.

rejectDialog.title: Reject {reference}
rejectDialog.body: The buyer is told the payment couldn’t be matched and can try again.

payoutDialog.title: Payout for {order}
payoutDialog.body: {amount} to {factory}. Record it once the bank transfer has gone out.
payoutDialog.settlementHint: Pick another currency if the factory was paid in it; today’s stored rate converts it.

ledger.title: Ledger by currency
ledger.explain: Reconciled means debits equal credits, cash equals escrow + payables + revenue, and cash matches the payments recorded in and out. Totals above are in USD at the stored rates.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account, with its company and moderation record.
users.emptyBody: People appear here when they sign up.
users.violations: {count, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}} (30 days)

warn.title: Warn {name}
warn.body: They see the warning in the app with your note.
warn.placeholder: e.g. Please keep phone numbers and emails out of messages: GarmentGate relays everything.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.body: They are signed out everywhere within minutes and can’t sign in until reactivated. Their company and orders are unaffected.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Everything staff and the platform did: who, what and on which record.
audit.emptyBody: Pick a longer period to see older entries.
audit.capped: Showing the latest 2,000 entries. Pick a shorter period to see everything in it.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Certificates factories added after verification. Buyers only see verified ones.
certifications.verified: Certificate verified: buyers can see it now
certifications.rejected: Certificate rejected: the factory has been told why
certifications.rejectBody: The factory sees your reason and can upload a new copy.
certifications.emptyBody: Certificates appear here when factories add them from their profile.
